story_type: diver with possible decompression sickness, swimmer lowered into the sea, litter hoist from a moving dive boat (hoist cam)
hook: A diver came up off North Carolina. Something was wrong.
narration: A diver came up from the sea off North Carolina, and something was wrong.
He had possible decompression sickness, near Cape Lookout.
Rise too fast after a deep dive, and nitrogen in the blood can form bubbles. Divers call it the bends.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew lowered a rescue swimmer into the water near his boat.
Then a litter came down to the boat's deck.
[short pause] With the boat still under way, the crew hoisted him up.
outcome: The diver was hoisted safely and flown to a hospital in Norfolk, Virginia.
title: Diver with the bends off North Carolina
description:
On June 17, 2018, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew from Air Station Elizabeth City medevaced a diver with possible decompression sickness near Cape Lookout, North Carolina. He was hoisted safely and flown to Sentara Leigh Hospital in Norfolk, Virginia.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Elizabeth City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/608142
